title: Tormance: The False World
audience: Player experienced with Acts 1 and 2; no control recap

campaign_constraints.voluntary_movement: directional swipes cause ground-plane X/Z dashes only
campaign_constraints.attack: tap slash; second quick tap chains one blast; current confirmed screen-relative aim rule unchanged
campaign_constraints.damage: fixed baseline damage; no persistent damage growth

checkpoints.retry: restore coherent section/phase start, intended supplies and entry sun state; no active hazard; clear all replay data
checkpoints.backgrounding: freeze entire simulation including sun clock, cooldowns, previews, effects, capture and replay
checkpoints.resume: consume overlay tap; continue exact frozen state

sun_state_rule.state_effect: appearance, easier enemy flank and independently previewed local hazard state over fixed continuous floor
sun_state_rule.preview: outlined next footprint; silhouette icon and countdown ticks; full shape locks before activation
sun_state_rule.reaction_budget: recognition plus remaining dash cooldown plus one normal escape dash
sun_state_rule.occupied_patch_rule: preserve current safe pocket; delay outlined patch activation until player clears it; never create cage

crystalman_capture_replay_rule.player_aim_anchor: unchanged screen-space final finger-release endpoint of latest swipe
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.dash_sample: actual completed world X/Z start, collision-shortened final landing and resolved route; reject zero/rejected motion
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.attack_sample: next actually executed baseline slash before another completed dash supersedes it; record actual world origin, direction and footprint
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.optional_blast: record only if actually executed as second-tap follow-up; slash-only combination remains valid
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.capture_lock: after actual combo window resolves; one slot consumed once
never_sample_as_completed_world_motion: queued or buffered dash not completed
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.preview: whole finite sequence: origin, route, endpoint, slash arc and actual optional blast footprint; numbered order and countdown ticks
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.replay_origin: recorded world origin; no translation toward current player
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.replay_targeting: fixed recorded directions and footprints; no chasing, retargeting or screen mirroring
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.collision: stable floor/colliders through capture and replay; follow collision-shortened route; clip attacks to valid floor and blocking scenery
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.visibility: route, attacks, escape pocket and local tether must be readable within existing portrait camera; reject invalid capture visibly and safely
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.tether: nearby firm-floor low target at ordinary slash range
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.tether_reaction_budget: remaining dash cooldown plus one normal approach dash plus one baseline slash
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.initial_tether_hit_proposal: one successful normal slash per exposed tether; meaningful exchange count tuned from play
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.scenery_stripping: decorative only; void outside/below retained safe floor
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.retry: discard replay buffer/ghosts/transients; restore safe phase position and entry sun state; rearm capture
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.idle_recording_state: readable and safe; no hidden health drain or concealed impatience attack
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.escape_invariant: before playback locks, actual player position and remaining cooldown admit an ordinary dash with clear swept floor path and landing through all active recorded attack footprints; two combinations require a cooldown-aware route through the entire sequence
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.overlapping_attack_validation: count recorded slash and optional blast together if active times overlap; do not validate each shape in isolation
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.inter_echo_gap: recognition plus remaining dash cooldown plus one ordinary clear escape dash
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.sun_changes_during_replay: decorative only; no active solar lane, root patch or regular-enemy attack
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.invalid_escape_sequence: visibly reject recording before playback, re-arm safely, never silently alter captured geometry
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.capture_pocket_validity: each permitted pocket must offer at least one valid normal-dash/slash recording; rejection must not strand progress
crystalman_capture_replay_rule.playback_timetable: short displayed timetable using normal resolved action durations and recorded execution order; do not copy arbitrary idle wait between dash and attack

required_design_tests: experienced-player sun-state anticipation after one exchange
occupied patch, dash cooldown and safe-pocket preservation at sun changes
Latcher/Stalker priority with no unavoidable cage
real Echo source vs harmless reflection in grayscale/muted portrait view
source/warning/landing/recovery legibility in all environment kits
Sullenbode projected likeness separated from damageable false-world roots
actual world route vs screen endpoint, moved camera, collision shortening, queued/rejected dash and zero aim delta
finite single-slot then two-slot sequential replay with optional blast, no recursion and exact footprint

worst-case recorded slash/blast footprints, corner landings and opposed two-slot routes: clear swept normal-dash path/landing with cooldown through whole replay or safe visible rejection; valid baseline recording from every capture pocket
slash-only local tether reach without pickups using ordinary dash
background/resume capture, preview, replay, sun change and phase transition; safe phase retry
measure complete-level duration including transitions; shorten idle wait before adding encounters
